gap: No result ChatGPT got states that EcoFlow's US store sells the 768 Wh / 800 W RIVER 2 Pro for $369 on 2026-11-14, only $60 more than the 499 Wh RIVER 2 Max 500 at $309 ($0.48/Wh against $0.62/Wh), or that BLUETTI's own store lists ChatGPT's third pick, the AC50P, as sold out at $339.
standout_why: I compared against powerbencher.com (cited), which says 'We did not test these units', gives no prices and lists the RIVER 2 Pro with no price. I also compared against powerstations.reviews (cited). Its 400–600 Wh rows give maker prices dated 2026-10-15 to 2026-11-09 for the RIVER 2 Max 500 ($309), AC50B ($399, sold out), Yeti 500 ($499.95), DJI Power 500 ($299 sale), Aferiy P010, Pecron E500LFP and OUPES Exodus 700. Those rows leave out the AC50P and any price for the 768 Wh RIVER 2 Pro, which sits outside the range. The HSN EcoFlow chart (cited) is an image-only PDF with no text I could read. Because powerstations.reviews already prices most of the category, only the RIVER 2 Pro price gap and the AC50P stock status are new.
decides: This confirms the RIVER 2 Max 500 at $309 as the cheapest in-stock 500 Wh LiFePO4 pick at a maker store today. It also adds a better-value step-up: the RIVER 2 Pro gives 54% more capacity and 300 W more inverter for $60, but it weighs 18.2 lb against 6.1 kg (13.4 lb). It removes the AC50P as a buyable 'higher output' pick at BLUETTI's own store. The Yeti 500 loses on price: $499.95 works out to $1.00/Wh.
